rule: Companion Part 64: the Contemporary Resonance Survey -- a scan of current research against the protocol's own provisions and the fields it borders, run apart from any reading, from a frozen list of provisions, each with a search for agreement and a search for challenge; every result enters the sources register with its relation and grade, and a provision with nothing found says so. It runs monthly as a scheduled task of the Originator's (adopted 19 October 2026), never inside a navigation, and the premise is not graded by it (L-490).

provisions.provision: the procedural value: an unchosen constraint interrupts habitual framing (IN-17.5)
the cognitive value: a reading widens attention (IN-17.5; Companion 33.10)
provisions.agree: perspective prompts widen consideration of alternatives experiment
provisions.challenge: structured prompts no effect on decision quality

provisions.provision: the jurisdiction: an AI that informs judgment and never occupies it (L-463, L-441)
provisions.agree: AI design preserving human agency decision support
provisions.challenge: generative AI cognitive offloading critical thinking

provisions.provision: surface form decides the address, and a model's output depends on the form it is given (Part 0.10, L4; M238)
identical rules give identical results across architectures (SR-CAS)
provisions.agree: LLM instruction following consistency across models benchmark
provisions.challenge: LLM nondeterminism same prompt different outputs

provisions.provision: a decoy control separates a coordinate's contribution from the Navigator's training (M267)
provisions.agree: placebo control prompts evaluation of LLM creativity
provisions.challenge: human raters cannot distinguish AI outputs conditioned on random seeds

provisions.provision: the arithmetic of the structure: Pisano periods, the norm, Catalan's identity (Core Part 1)
provisions.challenge: (the arithmetic is recomputed; a source can only state it alike)

provisions.provision: totality accounts of what exists (F-02, F-04)
consciousness read as ground, act and event (Core L-498; Companion Part 52, CT-42)
provisions.agree: integrated information theory global workspace adversarial collaboration results
provisions.challenge: adversarial collaboration consciousness theories predictions failed

provisions.provision: what exists is a structure, and there is no outside to it (F-02, F-04)
a coordinate conditions generation by selectively activating learned representations (Stratum 2; Step 9.8)
provisions.agree: activation steering interpretability features large language models
provisions.challenge: prompt conditioning effects on LLM outputs superficial

provisions.provision: counting is a primitive act of distinction, and each medium has its own boundaries (CPDP; L-501)
provisions.agree: cross-linguistic universals of word length and syllable structure
provisions.challenge: tokenization disparities across languages in language models

schedule: monthly, the first day of each month, 07:52 UTC (a scheduled task, a fresh session each run)
